transcript: The following notice gives details for a planned activity. Welcome to the Local Food Lab tour at the community hall. We will first visit the model room, then the photo hall, and finally the workshop. Photography is allowed in the first two rooms but not in the workshop. Keep your ticket because the guide will check it at the last door.
